steps.content: The sound of rustling wakes you up from a chaotic dream.
The noise directs your gaze to the front door—it's wide open. You instantly jolt awake, spring up from the couch and cautiously approach the door.
As you get closer to the front door, the sound of scrubbing grows clearer. The sharp yet familiar smell of cleaner wafts towards you, and it somehow reassures you.
At the door, you see Angell tossing a cloth stained with dark red spots into a black trash bag.
She strides to the end of the hallway, opens the trash chute door, and tosses the bag in with one hand. Moments later, a thud of the heavy object landing echoes up the chute.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Yes. It's all taken care of, you can go back to sleep.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's fine. It's time to get up anyway.
